title: Non-perpetual locks gaining extra delegation power
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** Medium  **Likelihood:** High  ## Description  The `vePeg._delegate()` function requires that the source token (`_from`) must be perpetually locked before allowing delegation. However, the `_moveAllDelegates()` function ignores this restriction and moves ALL tokens owned by the user to the new delegate, including non-perpetual locks.
